title: Record a push's finding that the newest copy is missing, so backup status stops qualifying it at once
outcome: Record a push's finding that the newest copy is missing, so backup status stops qualifying it at once
acceptance: When a push's confirmation finds the newest receipt's copy missing or changed and the replacement then fails, the state records that finding with its time, and the freshness rule reports `backup_copy_missing` for that receipt; a test covers it
disposal_reason: Folded into w-cb8f64e04546, landed as 63f046d. When push's confirmation finds the newest copy missing, it records the finding (missing_copy) before preparing the replacement, so a failed replacement leaves it recorded. The test is a_missing_newest_copy_is_recorded_before_its_replacement_so_a_failed_replacement_leaves_it. The freshness rule that turns the finding into backup_copy_missing is S2, w-1dd24a10891b.
